---
description: "Set State Value: Set a key-value pair in the agdt state"
---

## User Input

```text
$ARGUMENTS
```

You **MUST** consider the user input before proceeding (if not empty).

## Purpose

Set a key-value pair in the agentic-devtools state store.

## Prerequisites

No prerequisites required.

## Actions

1. Run the command:

   ```bash
   agdt-set <key> <value>
   ```

## Expected Outcome

The specified key is set to the given value in the state store.

## Next Step

Command is complete.
